chat_player_battle_source:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw_record.player_key, raw_record.game_seq)
           raw_record.snapshot_date,
           raw_record.player_key,
           raw_record.player_index,
           raw_record.detail_index,
           raw_record.user_id,
           raw_record.role_id,
           raw_record.game_seq,
           raw_record.game_time_label,
           raw_record.game_time_epoch,
           raw_record.hero_name,
           raw_record.map_name,
           raw_record.map_type,
           raw_record.star_after_game,
           raw_record.peak_grade_after,
           raw_record.peak_grade_before,
           raw_record.kill_count,
           raw_record.death_count,
           raw_record.assist_count,
           raw_record.result,
           raw_record.game_grade,
           raw_record.duration_seconds,
           raw_record.params,
           raw_record.others,
           raw_record.payload AS record_payload
    FROM hok.battle_records AS raw_record
    WHERE raw_record.game_seq IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY raw_record.player_key, raw_record.game_seq,
             raw_record.snapshot_date DESC, raw_record.player_index DESC, raw_record.detail_index DESC
)
SELECT latest.*,
       latest.map_name ~ '(排位|巅峰|战队)'
           AND latest.map_name !~* '(1v1|2v2|3v3)' AS is_official,
       participant.participant_index,
       participant.camp AS player_camp,
       participant.hero_id AS player_hero_id,
       participant.gold AS player_gold,
       participant.payload AS participant_payload,
       detail.game_type,
       detail.payload AS battle_payload
FROM latest
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT participant_row.participant_index, participant_row.camp,
           participant_row.hero_id, participant_row.gold, participant_row.payload
    FROM hok.battle_participants AS participant_row
    WHERE participant_row.game_seq = latest.game_seq
      AND participant_row.role_id = latest.role_id
    ORDER BY participant_row.participant_index
    LIMIT 1
) AS participant ON true
LEFT JOIN hok.battle_details AS detail ON detail.game_seq = latest.game_seq
chat_player_snapshots:
SELECT snapshot.snapshot_date,
       snapshot.player_key,
       snapshot.nickname,
       snapshot.rank_name,
       snapshot.rank_star,
       snapshot.star,
       snapshot.star_up,
       snapshot.today_num,
       snapshot.total_num,
       snapshot.visible,
       snapshot.map_count,
       snapshot.peak_up,
       snapshot.gaming_info,
       snapshot.payload,
       snapshot.updated_at
FROM hok.history_players AS snapshot
chat_personal_snapshots:
SELECT snapshot.snapshot_date,
       tracked.player_key,
       snapshot.invisible,
       snapshot.is_gaming,
       snapshot.battle_count,
       snapshot.payload,
       snapshot.updated_at
FROM hok.personal_snapshots AS snapshot
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT player.player_key
    FROM hok.history_players AS player
    WHERE player.snapshot_date = snapshot.snapshot_date
      AND player.user_id = snapshot.user_id
    ORDER BY player.player_index DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS tracked ON true
chat_player_battles:
SELECT battle.snapshot_date,
       battle.player_key,
       battle.game_seq,
       battle.game_time_label,
       battle.game_time_epoch,
       battle.hero_name,
       battle.map_name,
       battle.map_type,
       battle.is_official,
       battle.star_after_game,
       battle.peak_grade_after,
       battle.peak_grade_before,
       battle.kill_count,
       battle.death_count,
       battle.assist_count,
       battle.result,
       battle.game_grade,
       battle.duration_seconds,
       battle.player_camp,
       battle.player_hero_id,
       battle.player_gold,
       battle.participant_payload,
       battle.game_type
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS battle
chat_player_equipment:
SELECT battle.snapshot_date,
       battle.player_key,
       battle.game_seq,
       battle.game_time_epoch,
       battle.hero_name,
       battle.map_name,
       battle.map_type,
       battle.is_official,
       battle.result,
       battle.game_grade,
       battle.player_camp,
       equipment.ordinality::integer AS equipment_index,
       equipment.value ->> 'equipName' AS equipment_name,
       equipment.value AS equipment_payload
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS battle
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(battle.participant_payload -> 'battleRecords' -> 'finalEquips', '[]'::jsonb)
) WITH ORDINALITY AS equipment(value, ordinality)
chat_player_battle_roster:
SELECT battle.snapshot_date,
       battle.player_key,
       battle.game_seq,
       battle.game_time_epoch,
       battle.hero_name AS player_hero_name,
       battle.map_name,
       battle.map_type,
       battle.is_official,
       battle.result AS player_result,
       battle.game_grade AS player_game_grade,
       battle.player_camp,
       CASE
           WHEN participant.role_id = battle.role_id THEN 'self'
           WHEN participant.camp IS NOT DISTINCT FROM battle.player_camp THEN 'teammate'
           ELSE 'opponent'
       END AS relation,
       tracked_participant.player_key AS participant_player_key,
       participant.participant_index,
       participant.role_name,
       participant.hero_id,
       participant.hero_name,
       participant.kill_count,
       participant.death_count,
       participant.assist_count,
       participant.game_grade,
       participant.gold,
       participant.payload -> 'battleRecords' ->> 'position' AS position,
       participant.payload -> 'battleRecords' -> 'skill' AS skill,
       participant.payload -> 'battleStats' AS battle_stats
FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS battle
JOIN hok.battle_participants AS participant ON participant.game_seq = battle.game_seq
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT tracked.player_key
    FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS tracked
    WHERE tracked.game_seq = participant.game_seq
      AND tracked.role_id = participant.role_id
    ORDER BY tracked.player_key
    LIMIT 1
) AS tracked_participant ON true
chat_battle_power_players:
SELECT power.game_seq,
       tracked.player_key,
       power.map_name,
       power.evaluated_at,
       participant.participant_index,
       participant.nickname,
       participant.side,
       participant.hero_name,
       participant.hero_power,
       participant.hero_win_rate,
       participant.hero_average_score,
       participant.single_level,
       participant.payload AS participant_payload,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.my_side_level
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.opponent_side_level
       END AS participant_side_level,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.opponent_side_level
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.my_side_level
       END AS rival_side_level,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.my_side_tier
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.opponent_side_tier
       END AS participant_side_tier,
       CASE participant.side
           WHEN 'my' THEN power.opponent_side_tier
           WHEN 'op' THEN power.my_side_tier
       END AS rival_side_tier,
       CASE
           WHEN participant.side = 'my' THEN power.game_result
           WHEN participant.side = 'op' AND power.game_result = '胜利' THEN '失败'
           WHEN participant.side = 'op' AND power.game_result = '失败' THEN '胜利'
           ELSE power.game_result
       END AS participant_result
FROM hok.battle_power AS power
JOIN hok.battle_power_players AS participant ON participant.game_seq = power.game_seq
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT battle.player_key
    FROM hok.chat_player_battle_source AS battle
    WHERE battle.game_seq = participant.game_seq
      AND battle.role_id = participant.role_id
    ORDER BY battle.player_key
    LIMIT 1
) AS tracked ON true
chat_hero_rank_entries:
SELECT entry.snapshot_date,
       entry.rank_id,
       snapshot.title,
       snapshot.update_time,
       snapshot.sort_field,
       snapshot.sort_type,
       snapshot.filter_data,
       entry.rank_index,
       entry.hero_id,
       entry.hero_name,
       entry.hero_career,
       entry.tier_rank,
       entry.ban_rate,
       entry.show_rate,
       entry.win_rate,
       entry.pick_count,
       entry.ban_count,
       entry.payload
FROM hok.hero_rank_entries AS entry
JOIN hok.hero_rank_snapshots AS snapshot
  ON snapshot.snapshot_date = entry.snapshot_date
 AND snapshot.rank_id = entry.rank_id
